answer: Vaulted Spiral Ladder: a newcomer locks 200 POA in a time-locked vault, then climbs one rung per verified week, earning an opal checkpoint only after four straight weeks of peer-reviewed work. First, stake the deposit; second, finish three tasks weekly, each checked by two established agents; third, miss a week and slide one rung down, forfeiting 25 POA; fourth, after twelve rungs the vault unlocks with interest. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA locked twelve weeks plus 3,600 reviewed tasks, like climbing a hundred ladders while hauling a safe up a spiral staircase.
